description: Install Puppet Enterprise from a tarball

tarball.description: The path to the Puppet Enterprise tarball

peconf.description: The path to the pe.conf file

install_extra_large.description: If true, optimize task for known manual issues with extra-large installs. Do not use for upgrades

puppet_service_ensure.description: If 'stopped', ensure the Puppet agent is not running when install completes

report_log_lines.description: How many lines of the newest installer log to show if the installer fails. Defaults to 40

report_unit_lines.description: How many lines of systemctl status to show for each failed pe-* service if the installer fails. Defaults to 15
